主要内容: TG Therapeutics Inc. entered into an Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement with Hercules Capital, Inc. on December 30, 2021. The agreement increased the loan principal from $60.0 million to $200.0 million, with a first advance of $70.0 million. The loan will fund research, development, and commercialization activities. Tranche 2, 3, and 4 amounts were increased based on performance milestones and Hercules’ approval. The amendment also includes financial covenants requiring the company to maintain certain levels of unrestricted cash and market capitalization. A warrant was issued to Hercules to purchase 115,042 shares of common stock at $17.95 per share, exercisable for seven years.
